title: Workspaces treats MS Sticky Notes (new) as instances of MS OneNote
summary: Workspaces launches OneNote instead of restoring the new Sticky Notes windows.

reproduce.title: Investigate Sticky Notes workspace identity
reproduce.version_requirement: Use the current PowerToys release and compare the reported version if practical.
prerequisites: Use a Windows test machine and preserve the original configuration.
setup: Use a test machine with the new Sticky Notes and OneNote installed; create a disposable workspace with multiple notes.
steps: 1. Open and position multiple new Sticky Notes windows.
2. Capture and save a workspace with a desktop shortcut, then close the application windows.
3. Launch the workspace and observe which application opens and where windows are placed.
4. Compare captured application identity and launch target with the actual Sticky Notes and OneNote process identities.
reproduce.expected_result: The workspace does not mistake Sticky Notes windows for unrelated OneNote windows.
